name: active_aero_controller_wrap
description: Synthesizable ASIC-friendly active aerodynamics controller wrapper that samples vehicle geometry and flow-condition inputs, generates monotonic requests to an external DoMINO model service, validates returned model responses by sequence and freshness, computes bounded actuator targets from validated outputs, clamps outputs to programmable safe limits, and asserts a registered safe fallback state whenever invalid input, stale/timeout, malformed response, or interface faults occur.

fixed_assumptions: Single primary synchronous clock domain only.
All sequential state is updated on the rising edge of clk.
Active-high synchronous reset is used on reset_n.
No combinational feedback loops are permitted.
External DoMINO model service is purely transactional and outside RTL scope.
Geometry input is framed metadata plus payload-handle/descriptor storage; no STL parsing is implemented in RTL.

functionality: This block implements the complete control-plane wrapper around an external aerodynamics model service. It samples framed vehicle_geometry inputs and flow_conditions inputs into internal registers, enforces the 20 to 55 m/s velocity operating envelope, generates a single outstanding model_request transaction with a monotonic request_id sequence, tracks outstanding request age, validates model_response sequence matching and freshness, rejects stale, duplicated, out-of-order, malformed, and timed-out responses, computes deterministic actuator targets from validated model outputs using bounded synthesizable arithmetic/threshold logic, clamps each actuator channel to programmable min/max limits, optionally rate-limits per-channel command changes, and drives registered glitch-free actuator_command outputs. Any unsafe condition triggers safe_fallback_request and causes outputs to transition to a configured safe state such as hold-last-safe or park-position. Diagnostics expose live and sticky fault indicators for system software.
responsibilities: Sample and register vehicle_geometry and flow_conditions inputs before any request generation.
Check flow_conditions_velocity_mps against the 20 to 55 m/s inclusive range and assert invalid-input fault outside that envelope.
Generate a monotonic request_id and request_valid handshake to the external model service.
Track a single outstanding request, its age, and its timeout status.
Validate model_response_valid, model_response_id, and response freshness against the outstanding request.
Reject stale, duplicated, out-of-order, malformed, and timeout responses.
Compute actuator targets from validated model outputs only; do not infer or encode physics or surrogate-model logic in RTL.
Clamp actuator outputs to programmable limits and optionally apply monotonic bounded rate limiting.
Assert safe_fallback_request and hold safe outputs during any unsafe condition.
Provide registered fault and diagnostic outputs suitable for ASIC integration and system software polling.
reset_behavior: On synchronous assertion of reset_n, all internal state registers clear to a known safe state, including outstanding request tracking, monotonic counters, freshness/age tracking, sticky and live fault flags, clamp event indicators, and any latched validation state. request_valid deasserts, request_id and diagnostic counters clear to zero, fault flags clear except any reset-defined safe output indicators, safe_fallback_request asserts to force safe fallback behavior, and actuator_command0 and actuator_command1 are driven to the registered safe fallback value derived from actuator_safe_hold_value or the configured system default. No output may glitch during reset release because all externally visible outputs are registered.
behavior_rules: All state changes shall occur only on clk edges; combinational feedback is forbidden.
vehicle_geometry shall be accepted only as framed metadata and payload descriptor storage; RTL shall not parse STL contents.
flow_conditions_velocity_mps shall be range-checked to 20..55 m/s inclusive; out-of-range values assert fault_input_range and inhibit actuation updates.
Inputs shall be sampled into internal registers before request issuance.
Each request shall increment a monotonic sequence counter and capture geometry descriptor, payload handle, flow velocity, flow metadata, and age metadata.
Only one outstanding request is required; a new request shall not be launched until the previous request is resolved or declared timed out.
model_response_id must match the outstanding request_id exactly; stale, duplicated, out-of-order, malformed, or timed-out responses shall be rejected.
safe_fallback_request shall assert on any unsafe condition and remain asserted until a fresh, sequence-matched, validated response clears the fault condition.
Validated model outputs shall be consumed only after matching sequence validation; no surrogate physics is embedded in RTL.
Actuator targets shall pass through per-channel clamp logic before output registration.
Clamp logic shall saturate to programmable minimum and maximum limits and raise fault_clamp_active when saturation occurs.
Optional rate limiting, if implemented by configuration, shall be monotonic and bounded by the per-channel delta limits.
actuator_command outputs shall be registered and glitch-free at the interface boundary.
diagnostic_live_faults shall encode current live fault state; diagnostic_sticky_faults shall retain fault history until reset or explicit clear logic if later added.
The external model service interface remains runtime-independent and may connect to future NVIDIA-hosted NIM or ChipLoop GPU worker implementations without RTL changes.
All arithmetic used in control law shall be bounded, deterministic, and synthesizable in standard-cell ASIC flows.
